findings.evidence: Kinematics/Basic.lean:32-45 (DisKinematics fields) vs Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:32-52 (identical p/pPrime/k/kPrime/q/hqLepton); Polarized/Kinematics.lean:66 shows the `extends` idiom in-repo. `ExclKinematics` is never constructed with a structure literal anywhere (grep for `ExclKinematics` returns only type positions), so no call site breaks.
findings.fix: Declare `structure ExclKinematics extends DisKinematics V where qPrime / phiL / phiH / hMomentum`, dropping the five duplicated momentum fields and `hqLepton` in favour of the inherited `hq`. The hand-written `def toDisKinematics` then disappears as the auto-generated parent projection.
findings.issue: `toDisKinematics` is hand-written as a structure literal over the six fields `ExclKinematics` already copies verbatim from `DisKinematics` (`p, pPrime, k, kPrime, q`, and `hqLepton : q = k - kPrime` = `hq`). Lean generates exactly this projection, under exactly this name, when a structure `extends` another — the idiom the repo already uses at `Polarized/Kinematics.lean:66` (`structure PolarizedKinematics (g) extends DisKinematics V`, whose `toDisKinematics` is used at lines 80, 86, 247, 258, 269).

findings.evidence: grep `toDisKinematics_(p|q|k|kPrime|pPrime)` over `code/`: 5 hits, all in Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:180-197.
findings.fix: Delete all five lemmas together with the hand-written def.
findings.issue: The five `@[simp] toDisKinematics_p/_pPrime/_k/_kPrime/_q` lemmas are `rfl` restatements that structure eta already gives; with `extends` they are not even statable (field access *is* the parent projection). They also have no users: grep finds 5 occurrences of `toDisKinematics_*` in the whole repo, all their own declarations, and the single consumer in this PR bypasses them.

findings.evidence: Diffractive/Basic.lean:105-106: `unfold DisKinematics.xBj ExclKinematics.toDisKinematics xi beta DisKinematics.Q2 ExclKinematics.Q2`.
findings.fix: Use `simp only [ExclKinematics.toDisKinematics_p, ExclKinematics.toDisKinematics_q]` (or, after the `extends` fix, nothing at all) instead of `unfold ... ExclKinematics.toDisKinematics ... ExclKinematics.Q2`.
findings.issue: The proof `unfold`s `ExclKinematics.toDisKinematics` and reconciles `DisKinematics.Q2` with `ExclKinematics.Q2` by unfolding both, re-deriving by hand what the simp lemmas added in the same diff are meant to supply.

findings.evidence: Kinematics/Basic.lean:52-53 `def Q2 (g) (K : DisKinematics V) : ℝ := - g K.q K.q`; Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:59-60 same body; Kinematics/Basic.lean:68 `q_eq_sub (K) : K.q = K.k - K.kPrime := K.hq` vs Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:84-86.
findings.fix: Delete `ExclKinematics.Q2` and `ExclKinematics.q_eq_lepton_transfer`; after the `extends` change, `K.Q2 g` and `K.q_eq_sub` resolve to the inclusive declarations through the parent projection. Existing uses are Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:122, 150, 152-159 and Diffractive/Basic.lean:80.
findings.issue: `ExclKinematics.Q2 g K := - g K.q K.q` is character-for-character `DisKinematics.Q2` (Kinematics/Basic.lean:52-53); once the bridge of this PR exists it is `K.toDisKinematics.Q2 g` by `rfl`. Likewise `ExclKinematics.q_eq_lepton_transfer` (line 84-86, `K.q = K.k - K.kPrime`) is `DisKinematics.q_eq_sub` (Kinematics/Basic.lean:68). Keeping both is a parallel API, and the diff's own proof pays for it by unfolding the two `Q2`s.

summary: The new `toDisKinematics` def plus five `rfl` simp lemmas hand-roll the parent projection that `structure ExclKinematics extends DisKinematics V` would generate for free — an idiom the repo already uses for `PolarizedKinematics`; this cements a parallel record whose six fields are a verbatim copy of `DisKinematics`'s, and leaves `ExclKinematics.Q2`/`q_eq_lepton_transfer` as exact duplicates of the inclusive versions. The diffractive definitions themselves reuse `delta`, `tMom` and `Q2` correctly.
